d: Mokama men Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi men BJP ke purv sansad Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh helikoptar se pahunche. shadi samaroh men unhonne Anant Singh ke sath manch sajha kiya aur unki tariph karte hue kaha ki Anant Singh ka dabadba pahle bhi tha, aaj bhi hai aur aage bhi rahega. unke is bayan ki charcha samaroh men khub huee.
